name: debian-arm64
description: Tiny PoC rootfs with TCP loopback guest GPU bridge client, multi-frame clear-color stream, GLES shim smoke, clean extraction schema, dpkg-split smoke, apt/dpkg bundle, and static-glibc test binaries (/bin/mt-test, /bin/fileio-test, /bin/alr-ls) Wayland GUI test clients (wl_shm, pixman, input, interactive) and a full GTK3 library closure + service files with /bin/alr-gtk3-test. Includes GIMP 3.0.2 (full library closure, GTK3 GUI) and an in-process LD_PRELOAD path interposer at /usr/lib/androlinux/libalr_interpose.so for fast rootfs path mediation.
